reuse.why: Linking reuses linkSimpleFinAccount (with new syncSource/bankId options) instead of a sixth copy, and reuses findOrCreateBank/ensureAccountNotLinked, but the download path writes another per-provider fetch function rather than sharing one.

duplication.why: Linking avoids a copy, but downloadFintegraTransactions repeats the token/post/error/response-mapping block of the Akahu/Pluggy/EnableBanking downloaders, and linkFintegraAccount re-maps the account field by field for no reason.

placement.why: Handler in accounts/app.ts, download in sync.ts, server URL in server-config.ts and the type in types/models follow the tree's layout; making a SimpleFin-named function the generic linker is a slight misplacement.

scope.why: Only the edits needed for the new provider.

maintainability.why: Overloading linkSimpleFinAccount with a syncSource union and a redundant bankId (always equal to orgId) makes a provider-specific function a hidden generic one, and the download adds another near-identical copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses link.ensureAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and getServer as the other providers do.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions in sync.ts is an openly repeated copy of the per-provider download pattern, trimmed but not disguised.
